market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility expected. Oil at $108 and diesel at $6 create inflation pressure forcing Fed hawkishness. Morgan Stanley correction warning adds caution. AI sector faces OpenAI IPO delay overhang but infrastructure demand (TSMC, HBM) remains strong. Geopolitical headlines (Iran, Saudi pipeline) dominate risk premium. Expect 3-5% index pullback risk within 30 days.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure supercycle intact through 2027 but with regulatory/safety pauses. Higher rates structural, pressuring multiples. Geopolitical fragmentation (BRICS, Xi-Modi reset) creates trade realignment opportunities. Defense and energy structurally elevated. AI labor displacement accelerates, creating social/regulatory headwinds. Consumer bifurcation (value vs. premium) persists. 6-12 month: selective outperformance in AI infra, defense, energy; underperformance in rate-sensitive and consumer discretionary.
